items.markdown:
Finding a great gift for a reader comes down to knowing their vibe—whether they live for cozy nights in, love hunting down rare editions, or treat their `e-reader` like an extra limb.

Here is a breakdown of top-tier, reader-approved gift ideas, organized by style:

#### Tech & Reading Upgrades



---

A total game-changer for cozy or lazy reading sessions. Newer clipping-free or wireless options mean they don't even have to clamp a bulky device onto the corner of their e-reader.

---

Rechargeable Neck Reading Light Flexible, multi-brightness LED lights that rest comfortably around the neck without disturbing a partner asleep in bed.

---

Upgraded E-Reader / Tablet Case Look for a leather or canvas folio case that makes a digital Kindle or Kobo look and feel like an old-school hardcover journal.[[1]](https://everyday-reading.com/gift-ideas-for-readers/)

#### Cozy & Home Vibe

1. **Literary-Themed Mugs & Drinkware** – Classics like the *“The Book Was Better”* mug or clever literary teas/coffees from indie shops.[[1]](https://www.genuinefred.com/collections/gifts-for-book-lovers)
2. **Custom Book Jackets / Art Sets** – Companies like Juniper Books offer custom, artist-designed book jackets for classic and bestselling series that turn a standard bookshelf into a visual centerpiece.[[1]](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/best-gifts-for-book-lovers-rcna609989)
3. **Classic Literary Quote Scarf or Blanket** – Soft throw blankets or apparel printed with faded script from Jane Austen, Edgar Allan Poe, or Shakespeare.[[1]](https://www.uncommongoods.com/interests/reading)

#### For the Annotators & Journalers

1. **Transparent Book Highlighters & Page Tabs** – Gel highlighters that don’t bleed through thin novel pages, paired with fun shaped sticky notes (like speech bubbles or botanical markers) for color-coding favorite quotes.[[1]](https://www.genuinefred.com/collections/gifts-for-book-lovers)
2. **Reading Journal / Tracker** – A guided notebook where they can log every book they finish, track star ratings, jot down favorite quotes, and build their annual reading challenge stats.
3. **Personalized Book Embosser** – A custom metal stamp that lets them emboss *“From the Library of [Name]”* onto the first page of every physical book they own.

#### Fun & Quirky Stocking Stuffers

1. **Metal or Silicone Page Holders / Bookmarks** – From whimsical magnetic moth/mushroom clips to ergonomic thumb-page holders that make holding a 600-page fantasy paperback one-handed a breeze.
2. **Bookish Socks or Tote Bags** – Heavy-duty canvas bags with cheeky literature jokes or cozy novelty socks ("*Shh... I'm Reading*").[[1]](https://www.genuinefred.com/collections/gifts-for-book-lovers)

To help narrow this down, tell me:

- **Who** is the gift for (a partner, friend, teen, coworker)?
- Are they a **physical book purist** or an **e-reader/audiobook fan**?
- What is your **budget**?
